ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_min_abs_advantage_weight_normalization
ir.intuition: Inject weight normalization constraint to normalize pairwise weights by their sum per batch, ensuring scale invariance in weighting and preventing arbitrary scaling of the loss magnitude by total weight. This enforces consistent gradient magnitudes independent of weight scale while preserving the original loss sensitivity to minimal absolute advantages and margin smoothing.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
weight_sum = sum(weight) + 1e-6
weight_norm = weight / weight_sum
adv_min_abs = minimum(abs(adv_w), abs(adv_l))
margin = lpw - lpl
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
clamped_margin = clamp(scaled_margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss = hinge * adv_min_abs * weight_norm
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    eps = 1e-6
    weight_norm = ops.div(weight, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))
    adv_min_abs = ops.minimum(ops.abs(adv_w), ops.abs(adv_l))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(hinge, adv_min_abs), weight_norm)
    return ops.mean(loss)
